I'm 45. I've always "liked" Alice In Chains. About 6 months ago, I really started getting into them, and took a deep dive into all the music and what the bad "was". 
 I went all in on the music catalog. Read DeSola's book. Saw a bunch of live footage. 
 Goodness gracious....this is one of the best rock bands ever. The perfect combination- hard, heavy, deep, fast, slow, unreal great lyrics. It can't be beat. 
 And here's the craziest part: they've got like 40 songs. Almost all are great. Pearl Jam, Nirvana- hundreds of tracks. AIC has a small inventory, and it's fucking elite. 
 I love this band. Sad ending. But things do happen for a reason, and their legacy is untouchable. Best grunge band ever. Elite elite stuff. I can't listen to anything else. 
    submitted by    /u/F_b_s_40944    to

Purple Rain (Prince), Alive (Pearl Jam), Wish You Were Here (Pink Floyd), I Am The Highway (Audioslave), Nothing Compares 2 U (Chirs Cornell) e Heroes (David Bowie) é o combo perfeito pra me fazer chorar.
